newsitem.title: FRANCE: RESEARCH ALERT - IMI Sigeco cuts SGS-Thomson '97 EPS.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - IMI Sigeco cuts SGS-Thomson '97 EPS.

text.p: Brokerage IMI Sigeco said it had reduced its earnings per share forecast for semiconductor maker SGS-Thomson Microelectronics NV to $3.71 from $3.78 but said the share was undervalued.
SGS-Thomson reported a fall of 48 percent in first half profits this morning, in line with analysts' expectations.

"While there may be disappointment in the further delay in the (chip market) recovery, evidence from Texas Instruments and Intel point to an upturn and SGS-Thomson has historically outpaced market growth," said Denis Gross of IMI in a note to clients.
"Compared to Texas Instruments which trades on 31 times 1997 expected earnings per share, SGS-Thomson remains undervalued," he added.
